cards.headline:
Timekettle W4 earbuds add
12 offline language pairs
cards.body: An update adds 12 offline language pairs to the W4 Pro and W4 Plus for use without Wi-Fi or mobile data.

blocks.x: Timekettle's translation earbuds are getting a little more multilingual. A new software update for the W4 Pro and W4 Plus interpreter earbuds adds 12 offline language pairs. The W4 Pro has been around since 2025, while the newer W4 Plus arrived in September 2026. Both already offered offline translation; the October 20 update expands the number of supported offline language pairs from 13 to 25, covering 12 languages.

The 12 additions include Arabic, Thai, Italian, Portuguese, Indonesian and Vietnamese, each supporting two-way translation with English and Chinese. They join existing languages such as Japanese, Spanish, Russian, Korean, German and French. Online translation coverage also gets a boost, reaching 54 languages and 108 accents, with Kazakh and Khmer joining the list.

Supporting more languages doesn't necessarily mean understanding them perfectly. Regional accents, background noise and local expressions can still cause trouble, and the expanded translation capabilities haven't been independently tested. The update is already available to W4 Pro and W4 Plus owners, with no new earbuds required.
